_comment: The variant switchboard: every open design decision, its options and its default. Each layer reads only its own decisions (layer). applies: live (takes effect at once), next_fight, or next_run. built: false marks an option listed for the dev screen that no code implements yet; choosing it changes nothing. params are the option's tunable numbers. The player's choices are stored in user://variants.json as {"choices": {decision id: option id}}, holding non-default choices only. A decision with default_from takes its default and options from another data file instead (options_from). See data/variants/README.md. Every number in params is a first guess, not balance.

options.name: Banked charge toward the next action
options.description: While waiting, energy recharges faster by wait.recharge_bonus_percent (data/combat/combat_tuning.json).

options.name: Extra energy
options.description: Waiting recharges at the normal rate; starting a wait grants extra_energy_points at once.

options.name: Bonus damage on the next action
options.description: Waiting recharges at the normal rate; the damage skill that ends the wait deals bonus_damage_percent more.

options.name: Snap to the first affordable tick
options.description: A wait ends on the first tick the unit can afford the skill it waited for.

options.name: Choose an exact wait
options.description: A wait may name an exact number of ticks (1 to max_wait_ticks); it ends then, affordable or not. A wait naming none still snaps. Policies keep snapping; the battle screen shows a tick picker.

options.name: No effect
options.description: Elasticity is stored but does nothing.

options.name: Reduces big hits
options.description: The part of a hit above big_hit_percent of the defender's max hp is cut by elasticity x reduce_percent_per_point percent, at most max_reduce_percent.

options.name: Resists turn-order knockback
options.description: Every damaging hit knocks the target's gauge back by knockback_gauge, less elasticity x resist_gauge_per_point (never below 0).

options.name: Regains energy when hit
options.description: A unit that takes damage regains elasticity x energy_milli_per_point thousandths of energy, capped at its pool.

options.name: Current mapping
options.description: drift_rules in data/post_fight/post_fight.json.

options.name: Mapping by target choice
options.description: Only what a bot aims at moves it: drift_rule_sets.by_target in data/post_fight/post_fight.json.

options.name: Drift off
options.description: No decision moves a personality.

options.name: Per action (current)
options.description: Every tagged decision pushes its personality end once, so a bot that acts more often grows more.

options.name: Per energy spent
options.description: A tagged decision pushes energy spent / energy_per_push times, at least min_weight times (a free action or a wait counts min_weight). Slow bots act less but spend more per action, so growth follows energy, not turn count.

options.name: Named ranks (current)
options.description: Beam, Beam +1 to +5, Mega Beam, Mega Beam +1 to +5, Ultra Beam: data/combat/skill_ranks.json. Uses per rank rise; tier shifts add a power jump and a bonus effect.

options.name: Flat levels
options.description: Levels 1 to skill_levels.max_level every skill_levels.uses_per_level uses (data/post_fight/post_fight.json), each adding power_percent_per_level (data/combat/combat_tuning.json). No bonus effects.

options.name: Full heal
options.description: Every bot heals to full after each fight.

options.name: Carry damage over
options.description: Bots keep the hp they ended the fight with; a downed bot comes back with downed_hp.

options.name: Partial heal
options.description: Bots keep their end hp plus heal_percent of max hp, capped at max; a downed bot starts from downed_hp.

options.name: By act table
options.description: Each region's faction from regions in data/combat/factions.json (act 1 human resistance, act 2 enhanced humans and the rival AI, act 3 aliens and the rival AI); tier by act and defense level.

options.name: Mixed random per region
options.description: Each region gets a faction from mixed_pool in data/combat/factions.json, fixed by its id; tier by act and defense level.

options.name: Generic
options.description: No factions: the generic pools in data/combat/enemy_tables.json (scrap drones, rust hounds, sentry turrets, warden mechs).

options.name: Simulated auto-fights
options.description: The map's odds label comes from headless auto-fights of the current squad against the region's own enemy draw (fight/odds/); the panel shows the label and the win rate. runs and the label bands are in data/combat/odds.json.

options.name: Stat formula
options.description: The old placeholder: squad attack plus defense against the region's defense level (odds in data/tuning/overworld.json); no percentage.

options.name: Random
options.description: Every starting skill at random.

options.name: Damage guarantee
options.description: As random, but a bot with no damage skill swaps one in.

options.name: Non-strike damage
options.description: As damage_guarantee, but the basic attack does not count.

options.name: Separate (current)
options.description: Energy is a stock from region income and fight rewards; grid capacity regains power / grid.regen_divisor per point and pays for attacks, reinforcing and defeats.

options.name: One shared pool
options.description: Grid and Energy are one pool in grid percent (energy stock stays 0). Each point it regains (power + energy per day) / pool_regen_divisor; starting energy and fight energy rewards add energy_to_pool percent per point; it pays every grid cost. Capped at grid.max.

options.name: Map adds 1.5x (current)
options.description: The fight service charges the same on victory and defeat; the map multiplies a lost attack's grid cost by grid.defeat_multiplier (data/tuning/overworld.json).

options.name: Fight service charges it
options.description: The run's fight service reports a lost attack's grid cost already times defeat_multiplier; the map uses every result's cost as it is.

options.name: No surcharge
options.description: A lost attack costs the same grid as a won one.

options.name: Draft 5, field 3 (current)
options.description: draft_size and squad_size from data/bot_data/tuning.json.

options.name: Draft 4, field 3
options.description: The run's draft offers draft_size bots and fields squad_size.

options.name: Draft 6, field 4
options.description: The run's draft offers draft_size bots and fields squad_size.

options.name: Per-act tuning files (current)
options.description: Each act plays data/tuning/act*.json: today a 100-day countdown each, pressure scaled by region count.

options.name: Even length
options.description: Preset: every act a 400-point (100-day) countdown at attack 3, reinforce 1, wait 1, whatever the act files say. acts holds one tuning override per act.

options.name: Faster later acts
options.description: Preset: a longer act 1 and shorter acts 2 and 3, the same 1200 points in total. acts holds one tuning override per act.

options.name: Off (current)
options.description: Held ground only grows by attacking.

options.name: A simple version
options.description: From act from_act on, once a day every hostile region with defense at most max_defense next to held ground gains progress_per_day percent per held neighbor, focus_multiplier times that if it is (or borders) the region last attacked or selected. At 100 it is taken without a fight, at most claims_per_day a day. No dice.

options.name: On, at 1/3 and 2/3 held (current)
options.description: Each act has three alert tiers (data/tuning/escalation.json). Holding 1/3 of the act's map raises every hostile region one tier, 2/3 raises it again; tiers never drop. Enemy units follow the tier, and hostile regions left alone on alert fortify.

options.name: Off
options.description: Every region fights at its own defense all act and nothing fortifies: the difficulty before escalation.

options.name: On, at 1/4 and 1/2 held
options.description: As on, but the alert rises sooner: at 1/4 and then 1/2 of the act's map held.

options.name: Third loss in an act ends the run
options.description: Every lost battle costs stakes.loss_cost (data/tuning/overworld.json). The limit-th lost battle in one act ends the run; the count starts again in each act. Losing the boss fight always ends the run.

options.name: First loss ends the run
options.description: As three_per_act with a limit of 1.

options.name: Unlimited
options.description: Losses cost resources but never end the run; only losing every region or the boss fight does.

options.name: Energy moves, Material builds
options.description: Energy pays for REINFORCE and RETREAT; Material pays for BREACH (lower an attacked region's defense) and REPAIR (restore grid). Each use's cost is {energy, material} below; a use that costs nothing is not offered.

options.name: Material holds, Energy strikes
options.description: Material pays for REINFORCE and REPAIR; Energy pays for RETREAT and BREACH (an overcharged assault).

options.name: Tier from generation (current)
options.description: A bot's personality generation picks its tier: medium from medium_at, advanced from advanced_at. Read by the battle screen (ui/fight/battle_tier_rule.gd).

options.name: Tier from skill levels
options.description: The levels a bot has gained across its skills (each skill's level above 1, summed) pick its tier: medium from medium_at, advanced from advanced_at.

options.name: Tier from augments
options.description: The augments a bot has fitted pick its tier: medium from medium_at, advanced from advanced_at.
